notes.title: When is the game coming out?
notes.content:
Hello It is me again, Ferry, the developer, it's been a while since my last community post so I'm sure the three people that read it are salivating for more content.

As a few of you have noticed Undesired Catch has had it's release date changed throughout the development of the game, first it was coming out in september, then in november, and after that it stayed undefined.

This has happened because: 1. I'm an idiot and can't predict when the game will be finished, 2. I'm lazy and don't work enough to finish the game in time and 3: the game has changed quite a lot since I released the demo.

Thanks to the release of the demo I became aware of a lot of the flaws of Undesired Catch, wich I partially solved by updating the demo a few times, and by rethinking a lot of things regarding the final game, wich originally was going to be much more simple than it is now.

A few of the things I've done include: New map, New catch, Polishing mechanics (jails, crane, navigating...), Improving visuals, Adding new effects (water particles, extra sounds...) New designs for buoys and jails, Lore, an actual gameplan with a Beginning, Setting, and Ending, translations in all the languages said in the Steam page, and cool elevator.

So, when is the game coming? When it's finished. When will that be? I don't know, at this rate probably late next month, but I will not give another incorrect release date again. It isn't fair nor honest.

Again, I apologize for the incompetence, I've also been loosing a few wishlists these days wich I presume is because the game hasn't come out when it was supposed to, wich Is understandable.

Remember to follow me on [url=https://x.com/ferran_ferry]X[/url] (twitter) if you want to stay more in touch, and please feel free to ask anything you want!

notes.title: New update for the demo! Settings menu and more
notes.content:
Hello! 

After recieving a bunch of feedback from my beautiful 6 person community, I've made some changes that will adress some of the problems the previous Demo had.

For some (most) people positioning the boat to grab the F-POT's required too much finesse and was a frustrating experience, the boat drifted way too much and the slow player movement made it painfully slow to go back and forth from the crane to the bridge to make corrections on positioning.

To solve this I made a few changes. 

The player now sprints way faster than before, from a 20% increase in movement speed to a 60% increase!

The colliders of the grabber, buoy, and F-POT grab point have been increased in size to make the process of grabbing things easier.

I've added a monitor that allows the player to see in real time feed from a camera placed where the buoys are supposed to be to be grabbed, this will make it so that now you don't need to walk out of the bridge to know if you can grab a buoy or not.

Another thing I procrastinated about doing is now done, the game has now a settings menu!

It's simple and it will be expanded from now on but it adds a few essential things like a volume slider and V-sync toggle.

The enviornment has also been slightly changed, I've added a few more rocks and cliffs that where missing.

Some bugs where fixed, now the boat can be moved wile having F-POT's on board without the game going crazy.

That's it for today! Thanks for reading and I'm looking forward to more feedback, as always.

notes.title: The Demo has been updated!
notes.content:
Here is a very much not comprehensive list of (not) all the changes.

The delay for when you wanted to get up from a sit-able thingy is now removed (I figured out how coroutines work :p)
